name: PulseMesh Connector
author: PulseMesh Labs
description: Allow visitors to listen to your synchronized display audio from their phones.  Learn more at https://pulsemesh.io

privacy.summary: Lets visitors hear your show's audio on their phones through PulseMesh (pulsemesh.io). It keeps this player in step with PulseMesh's servers and uploads your song files for streaming.

sends.why: to check for and download a newer PulseMesh Connector

sends.what: song file names and fingerprints, what is playing, and your visitor-request playlist
sends.why: so visitors' phones play the right song at the right moment

sends.what: a request for the current list of time servers
sends.why: to find the nearest PulseMesh time server

sends.what: this player's hostname, a pairing code and its device token
sends.why: to pair this player and sign it in to PulseMesh

sends.what: your email, your message, the connector log and its settings
sends.why: so PulseMesh support can help when you send a support request

sends.what: your PulseMesh token and this player's hostname
sends.why: to link this player to your PulseMesh account

sends.what: clock timing requests, to this and PulseMesh's other time servers
sends.why: to keep visitors' phones in step with this player
so PulseMesh can stream them to visitors

collects.what: a log of song file names, pairing codes and connection events
a list of your media files with their fingerprints

systemChanges.what: downloads the PulseMesh Connector program from pulsemesh.io at install, on each FPP start, and when you switch versions
runs the PulseMesh Connector in the background whenever FPP is running
removes the port 8089 page allowance older versions added, and sets FPP's restart-needed flag after install

privacy.other: PulseMesh can start songs from the one playlist you choose for visitor requests; you can turn this off on the PulseMesh page.
